finding.question: Did the New York Post's editorial board endorse Donald Trump for another presidential term, and if so, in which election year?
finding.summary: The New York Post endorsed President Donald Trump for re-election in an editorial published on October 26, 2020, ahead of the November 3 election. Contemporaneous independent reporting also identified it as an endorsement for a second term.

report_raw.claim: The New York post Endorsed Donald trumps bid for re-election.
report_raw.justification: On October 26, 2020, the New York Post published an editorial explicitly endorsing President Donald Trump for re-election. [S1] The editorial referred to the choice voters would make on November 3. [S1] The Washington Examiner independently reported that the Post had endorsed Trump for a second term. [S2]
key_points: The Post’s own editorial explicitly announced the endorsement. [S1]
Contemporaneous reporting also identified it as an endorsement for a second term. [S2]
report_raw.counter_argument: The excerpts do not identify the individual editorial board members who approved the endorsement. Nevertheless, the Post expressly presented it as the newspaper’s endorsement, and independent reporting described it the same way. [S1][S2]
